tools.name: get_edition
tools.description: The published edition in full: title, lead, the "In 30 seconds" brief when the edition has one, the three vectors, the text blocks with each paragraph labelled FACT, HYPOTHESIS or SCENARIO, the indicators to watch, and the figures recomputed at build time.

tools.name: get_export
tools.description: With a member key: three signed links, valid seven days, to the complete export of one signal (bundle.json with the full dossier, counter-analysis and every series; organisations.csv; series.csv). Without a key it answers MEMBER_KEY_REQUIRED with the Premium plan.

tools.name: get_organisation
tools.description: An organisation named in the atlas and every documented exposure it has, across signals: direction (exposed, beneficiary, competitor, adjacent), evidenced or deduced, decision type, and the dated verbatim quote it rests on.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Premium is the only paid offer: 49 USD per month, every published analysis while the subscription is active. Review and rights limits remain; there is no agent payment.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Asks the free weekly edition for one email address. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_signals, get_dossier, get_series, get_offers, subscribe_newsletter · Private data: get_series · Public sink: subscribe_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_signals, get_dossier, get_series, get_offers, subscribe_newsletter · Private data: get_series · Public sink: subscribe_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
